source: Black Friday: up to 70% off everything.
raw:
{
  "literal": "الجمعة السوداء: خصم يصل إلى 70% على كل شيء",
  "adaptation": "الجمعة البيضاء: خصومات تصل إلى 70% على كل المنتجات",
  "back_translation": "White Friday: discounts up to 70% on all products",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "Changed 'Black Friday' to 'White Friday' because 'black' carries negative associations and Friday is a holy day in Islam; 'White Friday' is a common and accepted adaptation in the Middle East."
}
literal: الجمعة السوداء: خصم يصل إلى 70% على كل شيء

back_translation: White Friday: discounts up to 70% on all products
notes: Changed 'Black Friday' to 'White Friday' because 'black' carries negative associations and Friday is a holy day in Islam; 'White Friday' is a common and accepted adaptation in the Middle East.
